mcp_tools.name: strategy_backtest_validation
mcp_tools.title: Strategy backtest validation
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared backtest-evidence manifest (harness standards, protocol and reporting, costs and frictions, overfit and fragility evidence, paper-trading gate, live monitoring and house gates); get a deterministic VALIDATED / NOT_VALIDATED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including a recomputed parameters-to-data ratio reported without an invented acceptance bar, with per-check evidence. Declared evidence only; no backtest is run.

inputSchema.description: The backtest-validation manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

harness.description: Harness-standards evidence (determinism, snapshots, point-in-time universe, look-ahead, fills).

protocol.description: Protocol and reporting evidence (hypothesis, in/out-of-sample, holdout, walk-forward).

costs.description: Costs and frictions evidence (commissions, spreads, slippage, taxes).

overfit.description: Overfit evidence (parameter discipline, sensitivity, plateau checks).

paper.description: Paper-trading gate evidence (completion, or conscious waiver with reason and approval).

monitoring.description: Live-monitoring evidence (drift, live-vs-model comparison, kill criteria).

house_gates.description: House-gate evidence (incl. the declared clear-yes record for trades over the stated threshold).

expect.notes: All boolean constraints met. Computed params_to_data_ratio = 0.0100 (10/1000). over_500_trade_declared = true.
